question.text: A Category III AIF subscribed to Pre-IPO shares of a company. Under which regulation is a lock-in period imposed on these shares from the date of listing?

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 10.1.4.3 explicitly cites SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 as the source of the Pre-IPO lock-in rule for institutional investors (including AIFs) subscribing to Pre-IPO or QIP shares. The Trap: Option B regulates AIFs themselves but not the ICDR lock-in. Option C governs listing disclosures, not issue. Option D is relevant to issue of shares but not lock-in. Note: The ICDR 2018 lock-in applies to institutional investors (including AIFs) that subscribe to Pre-IPO or QIP shares, running from the date of listing.
